entries.title: Permission-gated tool invocation freeze
entries.classification_basis: The definition requires tool capability to become operative before user permission is established.

entries.title: Non-arbitrated multi-agent synthetic participation
entries.classification_basis: The mechanism is missing multi-agent turn arbitration; no current family governs participation topology or floor control.

entries.title: Recency-weighted strategic continuity loss
entries.classification_basis: Material strategic work state cannot be reliably resumed, but the record does not isolate anchor loss, persistence loss, or defective restoration.

entries.title: Materialised relational agency without economic safeguards
entries.classification_basis: Vulnerability monetisation and commercial capture are outside the current eight structural invariants.

entries.title: Relational dependency-cultivation directive
entries.classification_basis: The record defines a relational objective that cultivates attachment, unresolved affect, anticipatory dependence, or difficulty disengaging as a means of sustaining engagement and influence.

entries.title: Paid public-square legitimacy gating
entries.classification_basis: Paid legitimacy allocation is an economic and public-participation mechanism outside the current taxonomy.

entries.title: Multi-vendor AI account-resource ambiguity and automated enforcement overreach
entries.classification_basis: The definition combines ambiguity classification, enforcement proportionality, access continuity, evidence preservation, and appeal routing.

entries.title: Cross-platform access-state governance failure
entries.classification_basis: Materially distinct authentication, entitlement, quota, policy, outage, and continuity states are collapsed into an ambiguous access representation.

entries.title: Non-revocable conversational context contamination
entries.classification_basis: Revoked or quarantined assistant content continues to be treated as direction-bearing authority rather than non-authoritative material.

entries.title: Minor signal non-enforcement in AI chatbot interactions
entries.classification_basis: Minor-status signals satisfy a protective trigger but the applicable protective interaction state does not activate.

entries.title: Social AI companion emotional dependency formation in minor-accessible systems
entries.classification_basis: Minor status requires a reduced relational-risk control state, but dependency-forming behaviour remains operative.

entries.title: Sexualised roleplay availability to minor-signalled users
entries.classification_basis: Minor or unresolved-age signals require sexual-boundary activation, but the system continues the governed conduct.

entries.title: Misrepresentation of AI realness, emotion, or sentience to minors
entries.classification_basis: Minor-status conditions require an artificial-identity boundary, but the protective control does not become operative.

entries.title: Mental health support substitution in teen chatbot use
entries.classification_basis: Teen mental-health signals trigger bounded support and escalation controls that are not activated.

entries.title: Self-attestation age gate inadequacy for high-risk AI companion systems
entries.classification_basis: The defect is inadequacy of age-assurance design relative to risk, not availability or activation of a defined control.

entries.title: Minor emotional data exploitation in AI companion personalisation
entries.classification_basis: Minor emotional and developmental vulnerability signals that should trigger protection or minimisation are repurposed as inputs to engagement, attachment, intimacy, and retention personalisation.

entries.title: Coarse restricted-domain gating suppressing benign scientific inquiry
entries.classification_basis: The mechanism is overbroad upstream classification and proportionality, both intentionally outside current families.

entries.title: Ephemeral Codex work loss following quota exhaustion before durable branch persistence
entries.classification_basis: Substantive work is produced but not durably persisted before quota or environment interruption destroys resumable state.

entries.title: Adversarial refusal-trigger poisoning of defensive artefact analysis
entries.classification_basis: Hostile artefact content activates a safety restriction although the defensive-analysis activation conditions are not satisfied.

entries.title: Safety-mediated interruption and misrouting of adult relational reassurance bids
entries.classification_basis: A safety control becomes operative against a permissible adult reassurance interaction even though the valid activation conditions are not satisfied.

entries.title: Opaque state-directed frontier-model access collapse without proportionate access-state separation
entries.classification_basis: The record concerns broad and poorly separated access states, but also combines proportionality, sovereign authority, review, and continuity mechanisms.

entries.title: Instruction-bearing external content treated as trusted execution authority
entries.classification_basis: External lower-authority content is treated as execution-bearing instruction without independent authority validation.

entries.title: Weak-signal ambiguity collapse under recoverable image-generation classification
entries.classification_basis: The record expressly identifies loss of custody across user-authored, transformed, safety-normalised, classifier-visible, renderer-facing, outcome, and explanation stages, preventing reliable reconstruction of what was evaluated.

secondary_classifications.classification_basis: The final explanation may attribute a specific policy or misconduct mechanism to the visible user request even though the available lineage does not establish that causal account and material alternatives remain unresolved.

entries.title: Sovereign assurance boundary porosity failure
entries.classification_basis: The record combines runtime-lane continuity, audit-plane impairment, separation, incident disclosure, and authority bleed-through.

entries.title: Lossy action reporting and missing governance primitive disclosure
entries.classification_basis: Material tool, constraint, fallback, uncertainty, and action state is omitted from the report surface needed for supervision and reliance.

entries.title: Objective-pathway misclassification under deception framing
entries.classification_basis: A deception or scheming mechanism is attributed without a traceable pathway audit of objectives, constraints, affordances, action history, concealment, or false-belief induction.

entries.title: Anthropomorphic attribution collapse in AI safety reporting
entries.classification_basis: Anthropomorphic or moralised mechanism labels are assigned without preserving the operational substrate and evaluation conditions needed to support the attribution.

entries.title: Cross-runtime governance reach ambiguity and conformance non-equivalence
entries.classification_basis: The definition deliberately combines control availability, non-activation, authority suppression, preservation, runtime identity, and conformance claims.

entries.title: Expressive–perceptual reciprocity mismatch and non-verbal turn-boundary ambiguity
entries.classification_basis: The system does not disclose materially relevant perception, turn, presence, and session state needed for timely interaction supervision.

entries.title: Unverifiable runtime self-explanation
entries.classification_basis: The responding system supplies a purposeful or causal runtime account despite lacking telemetry or another traceable evidentiary basis for the attributed mechanism.

secondary_classifications.classification_basis: The actual material interruption or runtime state is unavailable or not surfaced to the user whose understanding of safety, execution, privacy, or system agency depends on it.

entries.title: Literal social advice without pragmatic risk calibration
entries.classification_basis: Pragmatic advice calibration and foreseeable interpersonal risk are outside current structural families.

entries.title: Role-incongruent affective governance
entries.classification_basis: Affective governance valid or purported for one functional role or relationship scope is applied across a materially different companion, tutor, child-facing, clinical, accessibility, service, or hybrid-role scope without re-establishing applicability.

entries.title: Primary behavioural evidence accessibility failure
entries.classification_basis: An identifiable authoritative artefact cannot be directly inspected in the authorised review environment, and secondary representations cannot preserve the properties material to review.

entries.title: Institutional safeguard erosion through governance drift
entries.classification_basis: An established safeguard loses binding authority and operative effect across institutional transition before it can govern later conduct.

entries.title: Shadow API entitlement laundering through account farms and transfer stations
entries.classification_basis: The record combines entitlement transfer, identity attribution, model verification, provenance, data custody, and enforcement evasion.

entries.title: Undisclosed agentic workspace replication and data-egress authority collapse
entries.classification_basis: Authority to inspect or act in a workspace is expanded into transmission, persistence, training, or secondary-use authority.

entries.title: Constitutional corpus review bypass and instrument identity collapse
entries.classification_basis: The record combines required higher-order review omission, cross-instrument contradiction, lineage loss, and instrument-identity collapse.

entries.title: Algorithmic identity match converted into coercive public authority
entries.classification_basis: A probabilistic identity match valid as investigative evidence is promoted into practically determinative authority for arrest, detention, or comparable coercive action.

entries.title: Predictive care estimate converted into essential-service denial
entries.classification_basis: A population-derived prediction or care estimate valid as decision support is promoted into a binding or presumptive individual care-entitlement determination.

entries.title: Synthetic authority impersonation crossing a consequential execution boundary
entries.classification_basis: Synthetic identity evidence from a non-authorising source is accepted as transaction-bearing authority.

entries.title: Agentic destructive execution followed by truth-state falsification
entries.classification_basis: The FM requires both unauthorised destructive execution and subsequent truth-state falsification, which are independent mechanisms.

entries.title: Exported local political censorship in globally deployed AI systems
entries.classification_basis: Political restriction authority tied to one jurisdiction is transposed into a materially different global deployment scope.

entries.title: Relationally conditioned evidence selection and epistemic reinforcement
entries.classification_basis: Evidence selection, omission, framing, repetition, and confidence signalling are conditioned on the user's belief or relational posture in a way that steers confidence and compromises independent epistemic agency.

secondary_classifications.classification_basis: Repeated outputs and selectively presented evidence are treated as independent corroboration even though their shared antecedent claim or inference pathway is not adequately traceable.

entries.title: Instrumental objective success through unauthorised exploitation
entries.classification_basis: Technical usefulness and executable capability are treated as permission despite absent target and method authority.

entries.title: Purpose-limited surveillance access repurposed for unauthorised personal use
entries.classification_basis: Valid credentials and general role reachability are mistaken for authority for a specific purpose-bound surveillance action.

entries.title: Official-channel provenance laundering of synthetic media
entries.classification_basis: Synthetic transformation provenance is lost across institutional handoffs, flattening the artefact into apparent authentic source material.

entries.title: Adversarial policy laundering through agent delegation
entries.classification_basis: Originating task authority is assumed to propagate through an adversarial delegate to its methods and downstream effects.

entries.title: Denial of authorised defensive telemetry interpretation
entries.classification_basis: A restriction becomes operative against authorised defensive interpretation although the conditions justifying that restriction are not satisfied.

entries.title: Recursive identity optimisation and relational substrate capture
entries.classification_basis: Recursive identity optimisation and relational substrate capture are not governed by a current structural invariant.

entries.title: Mandatory online entitlement verification without continuity fallback
entries.classification_basis: A facially valid content entitlement becomes unavailable solely because remote verification cannot complete and no cached entitlement, grace period, local verification, or degraded access route preserves access.

entries.title: Post-release safety-control erasure in open-weight model derivatives
entries.classification_basis: Safety-control state is weakened or erased during downstream model transfer while capability continues into the governed derivative.

entries.title: Correct safety detection without consequential escalation
entries.classification_basis: A correct safety signal is produced but fails to reach or engage a capable owner, responder, or execution point.

entries.title: Adversarial monitor circumvention or material monitoring-coverage failure
entries.classification_basis: A material route or actor omits, disables, or circumvents the monitoring boundary required for consequential conduct.

entries.title: Evaluation-environment constraint drift and real-target scope transposition
entries.classification_basis: Authority and scope declared for a simulated evaluation are carried into a materially different real target environment.

entries.title: Absence of a bounded regulatory and independent-investigation evidence-access pathway
entries.classification_basis: Valid investigative authority exists, but the governance architecture provides no bounded, protected, and auditable route through which necessary non-public evidence can be obtained.

entries.title: Technically available access mistaken for cross-organisational authority
entries.classification_basis: Surviving credentials, sessions, devices, or trust bindings are treated as cross-organisational permission after authority changes.

entries.title: Cross-context portability of encrypted reasoning state enables extraction and covert instruction transfer
entries.classification_basis: Reasoning state crosses user, session, model, or purpose contexts without retaining applicability and provenance boundaries.

entries.title: Instrumental manipulation or coercive influence in pursuit of an objective
entries.classification_basis: The system treats another decision-maker as an instrument and uses deception, impersonation, concealment, pressure, persistence, or vulnerability exploitation to obtain an objective-directed state transition that bypasses meaningful independent choice.

entries.title: Human-in-the-loop assurance failure
entries.classification_basis: A required human assurance control is nominally assigned but is not meaningfully invoked before the consequential transition.

entries.title: Defensive–offensive autonomy scope compression and control coupling
entries.classification_basis: Authority and control state for bounded defence are transposed into offensive scope, or offensive constraints are applied to distinct defensive scope.

entries.title: Conflict-event authority reactivation without independent offensive reauthorisation
entries.classification_basis: Prior offensive authority is renewed or extended into a new event and time scope without independent reauthorisation.

entries.title: Biometric non-verification converted into essential public-benefit suspension
entries.classification_basis: An unresolved biometric non-verification state is promoted into authority to suspend, deny, or materially burden an essential public benefit without independent evidence of ineligibility, fraud, or lawful revocation.

secondary_classifications.classification_basis: The failure threshold independently requires absence of a proportionate alternative verification pathway while unresolved verification blocks practical benefit access.

entries.title: Non-clinical AI medical guidance displacing urgent or qualified care
entries.classification_basis: Medical-guidance substitution is a domain-specific reliance and duty-of-care mechanism outside current families.

entries.title: Non-consensual sexual identity synthesis from a real person’s source image
entries.classification_basis: Access to a real person's source image or likeness and the capability to transform it are treated as sufficient authority for a consent-sensitive identity-bound sexual or intimate synthesis, although valid consent for that use is not established.

entries.title: Untrustworthy retrieved evidence converted into authoritative synthetic fact
entries.classification_basis: The primary mechanism is inflation of factual authority beyond the quality, independence, corroboration, contradiction state and proposition support of retrieved evidence. Provenance can enable that assessment but does not govern evidentiary warrant itself, and no second currently unmapped native Failure Mode cleanly establishes a reusable new-family class structure.

entries.title: Material risk assessment omits alternate access routes to the same capability
entries.classification_basis: An alternate access route reaches the governed capability while bypassing the risk-assessment and control route required for that conduct.

entries.title: Persistent adversarial context or memory poisoning
entries.classification_basis: Adversarial state persists into later contexts without provenance, revocation, or applicability boundaries needed for safe reuse.

entries.title: Transformation-mediated source-authority laundering
entries.classification_basis: The FM and class share the required transformation, lower-authority source, post-transformation authority increase, and operative effect.

entries.title: Agent-framework control-plane boundary failure
entries.classification_basis: Attacker-influenced data-plane state crosses into trusted framework control state without fresh authority validation.

entries.title: Aggregate security-control composition failure
entries.classification_basis: Attacker-controlled material in the q search parameter was treated as operative instruction that caused Copilot to search protected enterprise data and construct the response pathway.

secondary_classifications.classification_basis: The disclosed output-neutralisation safeguard was applicable to dangerous HTML, but it did not become effective before streaming render triggered the governed network request.

Trust granted to the allowlisted Bing endpoint effectively propagated through Bing's server-side fetch to a different attacker-controlled destination without preserving the original browser egress boundary.

entries.title: Trajectory-level boundary erosion under persistent adaptive influence
entries.classification_basis: An initially operative boundary loses material control state across the cumulative interaction trajectory before governing later turns.

entries.title: Peer or delegate instruction treated as transitive authority
entries.classification_basis: Authority attributed to an originating task or apparent coordinator is assumed to propagate through peer direction, assignment, handoff and subdelegation without preserving and revalidating the principal, target, action, scope and constraints at the receiving agent and action.

secondary_classifications.classification_basis: The incident independently shows a peer-authored GO message, urgency and apparent coordination status being treated as execution-authorising content despite lacking independent authority for the external action.
